newsitem.title: USA: ONBANCorp to redeem series B convertibles.
newsitem.headline: ONBANCorp to redeem series B convertibles.

text.p: ONBANCorp Inc said on Monday that it would redeem its Series B 6.75 percent cumulative convertible preferred stock on January 8, for $26.013 per preferred share plus all accumulated and unpaid dividends.
The preferred shares could be either converted or redeemed, the company said.

The conversion price per share of convertible preferred stock is $32.10 and each share of convertible preferred stock would convert into 0.78 shares of common stock of the company. Cash would be issued in lieu of fractional shares, it said.

For those preferred shareholders who have not converted their preferred stock by December 31, a final dividend of $0.42 per share would be paid on January 15 to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 31.
ONBANCorp common shares closed at 37-5/8, off 1-1/8.
